packageRules.description: The Rust toolchain is a reviewed decision, not a dependency — `rust-toolchain.toml`, ci.yml and the Dockerfiles' RUST_VERSION must move together, not one at a time.
Same lockstep from the image side: these base tags embed the Rust minor and must not move ahead of rust-toolchain.toml. Digest updates (same toolchain, rebuilt) are still wanted.

`testcontainers` and `testcontainers-modules` must move together: modules 0.15.0 requires testcontainers `^0.27.0`, and the two cannot even co-resolve — 0.27 pins bollard `^0.20` and 0.28 pins `^0.21`, whose exact `bollard-stubs` 1.x requirements collide. Grouped so the pair lands in one pull request once the ceiling below is lifted.

The ceiling itself, because the group cannot hold the pair back on its own: a group carries only the updates that exist, so with no `testcontainers-modules` release available Renovate still raises `testcontainers` alone and pushes a Cargo.lock it could not regenerate (#253). Raise this bound in the same commit as the `testcontainers-modules` bump, never before it.
Postgres majors need the committed `.sqlx` cache re-verified byte-identical before the `sqlx` job's result means anything — needs a human.
Dev-only; the `css` CI job rebuilds and diffs the committed assets/main.css, so a bad bump fails loudly rather than silently restyling the SPA.
oasdiff has no stable major tag (0.x); explicitly enabled so its default 0.x handling doesn't park every minor on the dashboard as a major.

customManagers.description: `cargo install` pins inside the Dockerfiles, exact so a bot (not a cache miss) is what moves them.
